title: Text: CHC Thad Weber ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: For us no. For a team like Detroit, he’s worth it. Some worry about how he’d been in the AL. He’s a good 5, maybe a 4 for some teams. Stuff is good and he eats innings. Been HR prone.
